name: styleverse-ecommerce
description: StyleVerse - Enterprise Clothing & Jewellery E-Commerce Platform

scripts.build: cd server && npm install && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma generate && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
